import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933')
a=root/'provenance/formal_start_after_ninja_fix'
b=root/'provenance/aic_cache_contract_20260929_0230'
old=json.loads((a/'sha256.json').read_text()); new=json.loads((b/'sha256.json').read_text())
keys=[key for key in old if key.startswith(('python/sglang/', 'tools/sglang-simulator/src/'))]
assert len(keys)==60, len(keys)
assert all(old[key]==new[key] for key in keys)
assert (a/'tracked_changes.patch').read_bytes()==(b/'tracked_changes.patch').read_bytes()
i=json.loads((b/'identity.json').read_text())

assert not i['aic_import_source_match']['mismatches']

assert i['aic_revision']=='c5f139662be28b177ca9f62f83543bbf10f133a0'
counts=list(csv.DictReader((root/'verification/aic_cache_contract_dense3_20260929_0228/cache_contract_counts.csv').open()))
manifest=json.loads((root/'verification/aic_cache_contract_dense3_20260929_0228/manifest.json').read_text())
assert sum(int(row['rows']) for row in counts)==88830
assert sum(int(row['exact_alias_rows']) for row in counts)==0
assert manifest['source_unchanged'] and not manifest['gpu_fit_or_database_query_invoked']
for name in ('scorer','predictor'):
    path=Path(manifest['source_contract'][name]['path'])
    relative=str(path.relative_to(Path.cwd().parents[1]))
    assert old[relative]==new[relative]==manifest['source_contract'][name]['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'old_native_runtime_files_unchanged':len(keys),'tracked_patch_unchanged':True,'kernel_binary_matches_reference':True,'sdk_byte_matches':133,'latest_experiment_files':len(new),'cache_audit_rows':88830,'cache_alias_rows':0,'cache_audit_sources_unchanged':manifest['source_files_verified_unchanged']}))
